en.title: Count Even Numbers
en.description:
Count the even numbers in an integer array. Although the source sentence is truncated, the constraints and three examples fully determine how negative numbers, 0, and the empty array are handled.

The company source is still Unknown; the input protocol added by this site does not represent the I/O of the original OAMaster problem.
en.input: The first line contains n (0≤n≤1000), and the second line contains n integers in the range −100000..100000.
en.output: Output the number of even numbers in the array.
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for details.
hints: Watch out for empty arrays and negative numbers.
